name: privacy-pass-issue-request-encoding
description: POST /v1/pp/issue body as canonical CBOR: [token request], the token request being pingers-anon's RFC 9578 batched request (token_type || truncated_key_id || blinded_elements<2-byte length>), opaque here and at most 5 + 300 * 49 bytes (design B.4.8, D)
